'''Hozumi no Oyu''' (穂積老) was a [[:en:Japanese nobility|Japanese nobility]] and {{ill|Poet|en|Poet|qid=Q49757|lt=Poet}} during the [[Late Asuka period]] to [[Mid Nara period]]. He was a [[:en:court official|court official]] and {{ill|Man'yōshū|en|Man'yōshū|qid=Q834321|lt=Man'yō poet}}. His court Rank was [[:en:Senior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade|Senior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade]], and he served as [[Ōkura no Taifu]].

== Career ==
In the [[Daihō]] era (3rd year, {{ill|703|en|703|qid=Q23500|lt=703}}), Oyu served as a [[Sanyōdō Circuit|Sanyō Circuit]] {{ill|Inspector|en|inspector|qid=Q511138|lt=inspector}} (巡察使) while holding the Rank of [[Senior Eighth Rank, Upper Grade]]. 

In the [[:en:Wadō|Wadō]] era (2nd year, {{ill|709|en|709|qid=Q23514|lt=709}}), he was promoted to {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade|ja|従五位下|lt=Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade}}, skipping four Ranks. In the following year, during the {{ill|New Year's|en|New Year's|qid=Q109943356|lt=New Year's}} court ceremony under {{ill|Empress Genmei|ar|الإمبراطورة غيميه|az|İmperatriça Qenmey|azb|امپراتریس قمه‌ای|bcl|Emperatris Genmei|ca|Genmei|ckb|ئیمپڕاتۆر گێنمێی|cs|Gemmei|de|Gemmei|es|Emperatriz Genmei|fa|امپراتریس گنمی|fi|Genmei|fr|Genmei|he|גנמיי|hi|साम्राज्ञी गैमी|hu|Genmei japán császárnő|id|Maharani Genmei|it|Genmei|ja|元明天皇|ko|겐메이 천황|la|Gemmei (imperatrix)|ms|Maharani Genmei|nl|Genmei|oc|Genmei|pl|Gemmei|pt|Gemmei|ru|Императрица Гэммэй|sh|Carica Gemmei|simple|Empress Gemmei|sl|Cesarica Genmei|sv|Gemmei|ta|பேரரசி ஜென்மெய்|th|จักรพรรดินีเก็มเม|tl|Emperatris Gemmei|tr|Gemmei (imparatoriçe)|uk|Імператриця Ґеммей|vi|Thiên hoàng Genmei|zh|元明天皇|zh_classical|元明天皇|zh_min_nan|Genmei Thian-hông|zh_yue|元明天皇|qid=Q233224|lt=Empress Genmei}}, he participated as a sub-general under [[Ōtomo no Tabito]], leading horsemen, {{ill|Hayato|en|Hayato|qid=Q8184907|lt=Hayato}}, and {{ill|Emishi|en|Emishi|qid=Q932574|lt=Emishi}} warriors along the [[Suzaku Avenue]] parade.<ref>''Shoku Nihongi'', Wadō 3rd year, 1st month, 1st day entry.</ref> He was subsequently promoted to [[:en:Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade|Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade]] in [[:en:Wadō|Wadō]] 6 (713), [[:en:Senior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade|Senior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade]] in {{ill|Reiki|en|Reiki|qid=Q183057|lt=Reiki}} 3 (717), and [[:en:Senior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade|Senior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade]] with an appointment as [[Shikibu Daifu]] ([[Assistant Minister of Ceremonial Affairs]]) in {{ill|Yōrō|de|Yōrō (Ära)|es|Yōrō|fa|یورو (دوره)|fr|Ère Yōrō|ia|Yoro|id|Yōrō|it|Yōrō (era)|ja|養老|ko|요로 (연호)|ru|Ёро (нэнго)|simple|Yōrō|sr|Јоро|tr|Yōrō|uk|Йоро (ненґо)|zh|養老 (日本)|zh_yue|養老|qid=Q1373061|lt=Yōrō}} 2 (718). During this period, he delivered the elegy for [[Ishikami no Maro]], the [[:en:Sadaijin|Sadaijin]] (Minister of the Left), representing officials of Fifth Rank or higher.<ref>''Shoku Nihongi,'' Reiki 3rd year, 3rd month, 3rd day entry.</ref>

In {{ill|Yōrō|de|Yōrō (Ära)|es|Yōrō|fa|یورو (دوره)|fr|Ère Yōrō|ia|Yoro|id|Yōrō|it|Yōrō (era)|ja|養老|ko|요로 (연호)|ru|Ёро (нэнго)|simple|Yōrō|sr|Јоро|tr|Yōrō|uk|Йоро (ненґо)|zh|養老 (日本)|zh_yue|養老|qid=Q1373061|lt=Yōrō}} 6 (722), Oyu criticized {{ill|Empress Genshō|en|Empress Genshō|qid=Q235343|lt=Empress Genshō}}, leading to charges of [[:en:disrespect|disrespect]]. Initially sentenced to {{ill|Decapitation|en|Decapitation|qid=Q204933|lt=Decapitation}}, his sentence was reduced to {{ill|Exile|en|Exile|qid=Q188863|lt=Exile}} on [[Sado Island]] following the intercession of Crown Prince [[Shōmu]] (later Emperor Shōmu).<ref>''Shoku Nihongi,'' Yōrō 6th year, 1st month, 20th day entry.</ref>

He was pardoned in {{ill|Tenpyō|en|Tenpyō|qid=Q1199879|lt=Tenpyō}} 12 (740) during Emperor Shōmu's general {{ill|Amnesty|en|Amnesty|qid=Q185943|lt=Amnesty}} and returned to the capital. Later, he was restored to his former Rank and appointed as [[Ōkura no Taifu]]. In {{ill|Tenpyō|en|Tenpyō|qid=Q1199879|lt=Tenpyō}} 16 (744), he served as a [[Guardian Official]] (留守官) at {{ill|Kuni-kyō|en|Kuni-kyō|qid=Q1155335|lt=Kuni-kyō}} during the court's relocation to {{ill|Naniwa-kyō|en|Naniwa-kyō|qid=Q1042338|lt=Naniwa-kyō}}.<ref>''Shoku Nihongi,'' Tenpyō 16th year, 2nd month, 2nd day entry.</ref> In [[:en:Tenpyō Shōhō|Tenpyō Shōhō]] 1 (749), Oyu passed away on the 26th day of the 8th month. His final Rank and position were [[Ōkura no Taifu]] and [[:en:Senior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade|Senior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade]].

== Poetry ==
The ''{{ill|Man'yōshū|en|Man'yōshū|qid=Q834321|lt=Man'yōshū}}'' includes a {{ill|Tanka|en|Tanka|qid=Q258331|lt=Tanka}} composed during an [[imperial procession]] to [[:en:Shiga|Shiga]] in {{ill|Ōtsu|en|Ōtsu|qid=Q202907|lt=Ōtsu}}<ref>''Man'yōshū,'' Vol. 3, Poem 288</ref> and a [[:en:Chōka|Chōka]] and {{ill|Envoy|en|envoy|qid=Q5381413|lt=envoy}} written during his exile on [[Sado Island]].<ref>''Man'yōshū,'' Vol. 13, Poems 3240, 3241 (Commentary from ''Man'yōshū Kogi'' by Kashimo Masasumi).</ref>

''Man'yōshū,'' Vol. 3, Poem 288:
{{quotation|If my life persists  
Fortune may bring me again  
To see Shiga’s shores,  
To the waves meeting the land,  
At Otsu, where they arise.}}

''Man'yōshū,'' Vol. 13, Poems 3240, 3241:
{{quotation|In awe of the great  
Sovereign’s command, I cross  
Nara’s lofty hills,  
Navigate swift torrents, and  
Traverse rivers with vigor,  
Taming the wild tides,  
And passing through Ōmi,  
A lover's farewell marks  
The sacred crossroads  
Of Sasanami's shoreline,  
Eternal longing endures.}}

Envoy: {{quotation|I pray for blessings,  
To once again see Shiga,  
At Tangasaki.}}

== Genealogy ==
There is no direct evidence of Oyu's descendants. However, [[Hozumi no Noomimaro]] is sometimes postulated as his son.<ref name="Ota">Hozumi and Mononobe clan genealogies, as recorded in [[Ota Ryo]]’s ''Seishi Kakei Daijiten''.</ref>
